name: Slate Admin Console UI Block
description: A reusable operations console block with key metrics, searchable account records, and working record editing. Designed for product teams that need a focused admin surface.
whatYouGet: A scannable row of operational metrics with clear labels.
A realistic records grid with search, sorting, and working edit controls.
Responsive layout guidance and consistent neutral styling.
goodFit: Launching a product with an operational dashboard preview.
Creating a focused internal tool or admin page section.
notFor: A complete multi-page dashboard with live integrations.
A promotional homepage or brand campaign.
requiredInputs: Metrics, account fields, editable fields, and relevant statuses.

faq.q: Does this create a complete dashboard application?
faq.a: No. It creates one reusable page block with metric summaries and locally editable records; backend behavior and full application routing are out of scope.

faq.q: Can I adapt the visual accent to an existing product?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the neutral foundation and replace the single accent with an accessible brand color.

demoPrompt: /sl-slate-admin-console-ui-block Create a Slate Console-style account page for Vela Thread’s subscription software team. In order, show “Workspace pulse” with 1,284 active accounts, $48.2k monthly recurring revenue, 18 open support cases, and 96.4% service availability, last 30 days; then “Account records” with six entries: Pine Works, Cedar Field, Harbor Supply, Morrow Systems, Juniper Studio, and Westline Labs, each showing ID, owner, status, date, revenue, and version.
followUpPrompts: Add account status and plan filters without crowding the editable records grid.
Adapt the same console block for an inventory operations team.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
